title.zh: 浮与沉 · 排开的水托住了谁
title.en: Float & Sink · What the Displaced Water Holds Up

desc.zh: 同一块橡皮泥，捏成球会沉、捏成船会浮：决定浮沉的，是它排开了多少水。
desc.en: The same plasticine sinks as a ball but floats as a boat: what decides it is how much water it pushes aside.
